enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night in the bedroom with the fan on low and the air conditioner off to save energy
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up. Adjust fan speed to low. Sleep. Turn onto left side. Push blanket down. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn onto back. Kick off blanket. Sleep. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting changed into work clothes for the early shift
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Change into work clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast at the counter with toast, fruit and a cup of tea while checking the phone for shift messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out bread and fruit. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pick up phone. Check messages. Take toast from toaster. Eat toast. Eat fruit. Drink tea.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the health clinic for the morning shift, walking and using public transport in the already warm morning air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to clinic. Enter clinic. Greet receptionist. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending handover, checking patients, administering medication and updating clinical notes
enriched_activities.desc: Attend handover meeting. Listen to report. Take notes. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update notes on computer. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Coordinate with nurse. Attend team meeting. Finish documentation.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the staff room, eating a packed lunch and drinking plenty of water to stay hydrated in the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open locker. Take out packed lunch. Sit at table. Open lunch box. Take out sandwich. Eat sandwich. Open water bottle. Drink water. Refill water bottle. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw away trash. Wash hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical duties, seeing afternoon patients, coordinating with colleagues and finishing documentation before handover
enriched_activities.desc: Return to clinic. Check patient list. Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update notes. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Coordinate with colleague. Attend handover meeting. Finish documentation. Clock out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift, travelling in the hot late afternoon and picking up a few groceries on the way
enriched_activities.desc: Leave clinic. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Get off at grocery store. Enter store. Pick up basket. Walk to produce section. Select vegetables. Walk to dairy. Select milk. Walk to checkout. Pay. Bag groceries. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a quick dinner on the induction cooker and eating it while keeping the range hood on and the kitchen light on
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Turn on range hood. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add protein. Stir. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at counter. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing into light casual clothes after the sweaty commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Walk to bedroom. Change into casual clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV with the fan and only briefly the air conditioner, waiting out the evening peak air-conditioner tax before cooling the room fully
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on sofa. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Watch TV. Get up. Turn on air conditioner briefly. Turn off air conditioner. Sit back down. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust fan angle. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review study notes and plan the next shift, with the dehumidifier off and lights dimmed to keep energy use low
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open study notes. Read notes. Take notes. Open calendar. Plan next shift. Type schedule. Scroll through notes. Highlight sections. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue typing. Save document. Turn off computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping for the night with the fan running and the air conditioner set to a low setting after the peak tax period ends
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on fan. Turn on air conditioner. Set to low. Lie in bed. Close eyes. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn onto side. Sleep. Turn onto back. Adjust fan. Sleep. Turn onto other side. Pull blanket. Sleep.
